description.value: Forming an image from a creature’s mind and experiences, you summon forth a spectral silhouette of a creature barring the resemblance in the creature’s mind. This silhouette acts as a partner for the selected willing creature, aiding them in morning routines, meditation, and exercises. If needed, it can affect the creature’s mind to think of it as a sparring partner. Only one partner can aid one creature, and once it has aided one creature for 1 routine it dissipates. If a partner is not required, the creature can choose to save against it, otherwise, they can decide to let it affect them. The partner only affects the following instances: Meditation: For spellcasters who meditate at the beginning of the day after a rest, to recover Magic Points , the creature only requires 15 minutes for meditating rather than 30. Sword Saint : The battle tactics, weapon drills, and/or meditation in prayer undertaken by sword saints for their swordskills only takes 5 minutes instead of the usual 10 minutes. SeeD Operative : Acting as an instructor, the partner speeds up the meditation process needed for sharing drawn spells around other SeeD Operatives to 5 minutes instead of 10 minutes. This can affect 2 creatures per casting instead of the usual 1. Reading Books: The time it takes to read books is reduced, as the partner aids in reminding the user of his past readings. For the Blue Book , take only 30 minutes to read it rather than 1 hour. Adventurer’s chronicles , and similar 1d4 round books, take only 1d2 rounds instead of 1d4. A book of Puzzles reduces the maximum time from 1 hour to 55 minutes and increases the reduction of surpassing the intelligence check to 15 minutes instead of 10 for every 5 over the DC.
